{"id":"N412193.24","decision":"client_store","text":"Telltale settlement authority process: counsel sends an assessment and recommended range to General Counsel Marguerite Salvesen for the claims committee. Authority above $500,000 requires sign-off from CFO Cormac Brightwater.","tags":[]},
{"id":"N412193.25","decision":"matter_only","tags":[]},
{"id":"N412193.26","decision":"client_store","text":"Telltale requirements on experts: the client must be consulted before any testifying expert is engaged (three names per discipline, with prior testimony notes). Its regulatory affairs group, led by Odalys Fennimore, must review every expert report before service to check consistency with what Telltale told the regulator. The group needs ten business days, and reports may not be shared outside the firm and the experts until cleared.","tags":[]},
{"id":"N412193.27","decision":"matter_only","tags":[]},
{"id":"N412193.28","decision":"client_store","text":"Telltale reporting and handling requirements: a monthly written update and a call after significant events. An initial case assessment is due within 45 days of the client's engagement letter. Five business days' notice is required before any motion. Phase budgets are required, with variance explained over ten percent. All communications go to General Counsel Marguerite Salvesen with a copy to insurance liaison Thaddeus Wren. The firm should have a day-to-day contact, with a call every two weeks early on.","tags":[]},
{"id":"N412193.29","decision":"client_store","text":"Telltale guidelines: no contact with media, treating physicians, or Telltale employees below vice president level without clearing it with the General Counsel. Preserve all relevant product documents (a litigation hold applies). No more than two timekeepers at a deposition are paid for. Invoices are monthly in task-based format. Design engineering and complaint-handling records are confidential, and a protective order should be proposed before producing anything.","tags":[]},
{"id":"N412193.30","decision":"client_store","text":"Telltale wants a vigorous but measured defense. Avoid public filings that characterize device failure rates further than the case requires, because Telltale is in a regulatory inspection tied to its next-generation lead.","tags":[]},
{"id":"N412193.31","decision":"client_store","text":"Telltale's product liability program has a $750,000 self-insured retention per claim. Coverage matters go only to Thaddeus Wren or Marguerite Salvesen.","tags":[]},
{"id":"N412193.32","decision":"client_store","text":"Telltale tracks complaint data in Orrinwick, its complaint-handling database.","tags":[]},
{"id":"N412193.33","decision":"matter_only","tags":[]}
